concept: Turtle-style Donchian(20) breakout, ATR(14) 2.5x trailing-equivalent stop
hypothesis: Classic trend-following breakout should catch BTC's large multi-year trend legs even if whipsawed in chop.
pineSource:
//@version=6
strategy("BTC Donchian20 Breakout", overlay=true, pyramiding=1,
  process_orders_on_close=true, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent,
  commission_value=0.05, initial_capital=10000,
  default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
  margin_long=100, margin_short=100)
donLen = input.int(20, "Donchian Length")
atrVal = ta.atr(14)
upperCh = ta.highest(high, donLen)[1]
lowerCh = ta.lowest(low, donLen)[1]
longEntry = close > upperCh
shortEntry = close < lowerCh

var float longStop = na
var float shortStop = na

if longEntry
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    longStop := close - atrVal * 2.5
if shortEntry
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    shortStop := close + atrVal * 2.5

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=longStop)
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=shortStop)

    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    longStop := close - atrVal * 2
if shortEntry
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    shortStop := close + atrVal * 2

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=longStop)
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=shortStop)

strategy("BTC 4h VWAP EMA", overlay=true, pyramiding=1,
  process_orders_on_close=true, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent,
  commission_value=0.05, initial_capital=10000,
  default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
  margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

atrVal = ta.atr(14)
emaFast = ta.ema(close, 50)
emaSlow = ta.ema(close, 100)
vwapVal = ta.vwap(close)
longEntry = ta.crossover(emaFast, emaSlow) and close > vwapVal
shortEntry = ta.crossunder(emaFast, emaSlow) and close < vwapVal

var float longStop = na
var float shortStop = na

if longEntry
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    longStop := close - atrVal * 2
if shortEntry
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    shortStop := close + atrVal * 2

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=longStop)
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=shortStop)
